title: Defense brings up ‘favoritism’ allegations vs witness in 2018
summary: Defense counsel Mark Vinluan, during the trial, presented a 2018 news article about a letter-complaint alleging Tang of favoritism when she gave a retirement party for a retiring clerk-of-court.
